I start ratings with 5 stars. Toscalito lost 1 star for the 3 separate times I made appointments and showed up to be told they do not have my appointment on record. They lost another star when they made absolutely no effort to remedy that issue with the appointments. All I got was “sorry there is nothing we can do.” They lost another star when I finally was able to get in. They determined that my air filter needed to be replaced. Instead of calling to see if I wanted to get it done same day, they emailed me about it then called directly after saying my car was ready with no mention of the air filter. It seems Toscalito has no interest in providing any customer service as they know they’ll have plenty of other customers come through based on their location. Fine for them, but it leads to poor service on the actual vehicles when they have no price in actually ensuring that your vehicle is leaving there in the best shape it needs to be… as is proven by the air filter on my vehicle. It’s a minor detail but one that demonstrates the quality of care they take on your vehicle.

It seems some staff here have truly mastered the art of customer service — answering questions without even looking at the customer. Quite an unusual talent. Perhaps learning a little more about how to treat customers would be just as useful as knowing about tires

A capital waste of time and a brilliant show of incompetence. I had an appointment and dropped my car off to get the alignment checked. They had my car for more than a full day and did not even inspect it. I have been a customer at close to …

UPDATE: I was overcharged when I returned to get my front end alignment checked after making needed repairs from my prior service. Lesson learned.
PRIOR: Excellent wheel alignment with same day service at a great price!

My 1998 Lexus LS 400 displayed “tail lamp failure” on Friday night. On Saturday morning, I searched for who could replace it—just a few places were open. I chose automotive Clinic because of their high score. It was a good choice, and they deserve the score. Five stars from me.

Great customer service and support. Friendly staff and excellent location. Buzz and Jesus provided the best care for my car and myself! I had no idea I was getting a sparkling clean car back, they definitely outdid themselves. Should anything happen to one of my cars in the future, they will be my go-to.

Decided to give it a shot on account of the reviews, generally reasonable experiences from people I've met and long lead times for Tesla Service but thus far my personal experience has been quite abject to say the least.

To start, brought a Model Y in for general maintenance on Tuesday morning for rountine maintenance and 4 specfic items listed in the service request submitted the friday prior. During drop off I was informed that a quote would be ready in about 2 hours, but did not hear back until over 6 hours later, 40 min before closing informing me that they were not able to finish a quote that day but next day would be possible. The following day, I was informed around noon that a  quote would not be ready until the day after, and upon requesting an estimate of when the repairs could be completed was not provided a reasonable estimate. This so far is not a great experience but for what occured next.

Upon not reciving a reasonabe estimate as to the timeline of repairs requested or a complete quote, I called in 1.5h ahead and requested my tires be rotated and to make sure there was no miscommunication, submitted the same via text which was confirmed recived when they called back 10 minutes subsequent.

Needless to say, the tires were not rotated.

But wait there's more! My driver's seat also started loudly creaking at the slightest bumps where it had not prior. I suppose, generously, this was because the seat needed to be moved to access the sterring column and the mechanic that did not re-assemble it with due care because they supposed that it would be accessed again before it was picked up but it's  but I'm not sure how much I care.

Overall communcaiton left much to be desired, partial quote provided was >50% over Tesla's and service was neither prompt nor convenient as much as I am sympathetic to staffing gaps the overall value proposition makes no sense as-is even with 1st party wait times. Not being able to provide a tire quote after 2 full days is all pretty crazy for an auto shop.
